result.instructions: Tools for Clio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my matters are open, and who is the responsible attorney on each?"; "What tasks are due this week across the firm?"; "Show unbilled time for the Smith matter and which bills are overdue.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Clio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run clio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clio_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. clio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clio_who_am_i
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Fetch the Clio user this access token belongs to — name, email, subscription type, time zone and default_calendar_id (needed to create calendar entries). A cheap way to confirm the token and region are right. Clio: GET /users/who_am_i.json.

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_list_matters
tools.title: List matters
tools.description: Search and list matters (the firm's cases) with their client, practice area, responsible attorney and status. `query` wildcard-matches matter number or description and the client's name; custom_field_id + custom_field_value filter by one of the firm's custom fields (e.g. a court case number). Clio: GET /matters.json.

query.description: Wildcard search on display number, number, description, or the client's name.

status.description: open, closed or pending — or several comma-separated, e.g. open,pending.

responsible_attorney_id.description: Only matters with this responsible attorney (user id).

originating_attorney_id.description: Only matters with this originating attorney (user id).

practice_area_id.description: Only matters in this practice area.

custom_field_id.description: Only records whose custom field with this id (from clio_list_custom_fields) matches custom_field_value.

custom_field_value.description: The value to match. Checkbox: true or false; picklist: the option id; contact or matter field: the record id; date: YYYY-MM-DD. Text, checkbox, picklist, contact and matter fields always match exactly.

custom_field_operator.description: Required for currency, date, time and numeric fields (= for an exact match); leave it out for every other field type.

updated_since.description: Only records updated after this ISO-8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

order.description: Sort order. Default id(asc), the only order that allows unlimited cursor paging.

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

page_token.description: next_page.page_token from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

offset.description: next_page.offset from the previous page (used when a custom order is set; capped at 10,000 records).

tools.name: clio_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: Create a contact — a person (give first_name and/or last_name) or a company (give name) — optionally with an email address and phone number. Clio: POST /contacts.json.

name.description: Company: the company name. (For a person, prefer first_name/last_name.)

email_type.description: Label for the email address (default Work).

phone_type.description: Label for the phone number (default Work).

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_create_matter
tools.title: Create a matter
tools.description: WRITE: Open a new matter for an existing client contact. Requires the client's contact id and a description. Clio: POST /matters.json.

client_id.description: The client contact's numeric Clio id.

description.description: What the matter is, e.g. 'Smith v. Jones — lease dispute'.

client_reference.description: The client's own reference for this matter.

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_create_time_entry
tools.title: Record a time entry
tools.description: WRITE: Record billable (or non-billable) time on a matter. Give hours as a decimal (1.5 = 90 minutes); it is sent to Clio as seconds. If price (hourly rate) is omitted Clio applies the firm's rate hierarchy; if user_id is omitted it records for the token's user. Clio: POST /activities.json with type TimeEntry.

date.description: The day the work was done (ISO-8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD).

note.description: What the time was for — this appears on the bill.

price.description: Hourly rate override. Omit to use Clio's rate hierarchy.

user_id.description: The user who did the work (default: the token's user).

non_billable.description: Keep this entry off the bill.

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: Create a task and assign it to a firm user or a contact, optionally on a matter with a due date and priority. Clio: POST /tasks.json.

assignee_id.description: The user or contact to assign the task to.

assignee_type.description: Whether assignee_id is a User or a Contact.

matter_id.description: The matter the task belongs to.

status.description: Initial status (without advanced tasks, only pending or complete).

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: WRITE: Update a task — mark it complete, change its status, due date, priority, name or description, or reassign it. Only the fields given are changed. Clio: PATCH /tasks/{id}.json.

assignee_id.description: Reassign to this user or contact. Requires assignee_type.

assignee_type.description: Whether assignee_id is a User or a Contact.

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_create_note
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: WRITE: Add a note to a matter (type Matter + matter_id) or to a contact (type Contact + contact_id). Clio: POST /notes.json.

type.description: Attach to a matter or a contact.

matter_id.description: For type Matter: the matter's id.

contact_id.description: For type Contact: the contact's id.

date.description: Date of the note (ISO-8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.

tools.name: clio_log_communication
tools.title: Log a phone call or email
tools.description: WRITE: Record a phone call or an email on Clio's communication log, optionally on a matter, with who it was from and to. This only records it: Clio sends nothing. To bill the time, also use clio_create_time_entry. Clio: POST /communications.json.

type.description: A phone call or an email.

subject.description: Subject line, e.g. 'Call with client about settlement'.

body.description: What was said or written (plain text).

received_at.description: When it took place (ISO-8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-02T09:30:00-07:00).

senders.description: Who it came from: firm users and/or contacts.

receivers.description: Who it went to: firm users and/or contacts.

fields.description: Override the returned fields: a comma-separated list, nested resources in braces one level deep, e.g. id,name,matter{id,display_number}. Omit for a sensible default.
